entities.summary: Katipunan and Revolution, a transformative movement in Philippines (1892–1898). Emerged from Emilio Aguinaldo declares Philippine independence at Kawit, Cavite and José Rizal publishes Noli Me Tangere, galvanizing the reform movement. Catalyzed Execution of José Rizal by the Spanish ignites the revolution.
